title:
RATIO AND PROPORTION,
(SCALE FACTORS)
objective: LO: I can use scale factors to enlarge or reduce shapes and interpret map scales.

content.text: A scale factor is the multiplier that converts an original length to a new length. A scale factor greater than 1 enlarges; between 0 and 1 it reduces.
Maps and models: A scale of 1 : 50 000 means 1 cm on the map represents 50 000 cm (500 m) in real life.

key_idea.title: Key idea
key_idea.text: Scale factor = new length divided by original length. Multiply every length by the scale factor.
key_idea.caption: All lengths scale by the same factor

modelled_examples.label: Example 1 – finding a scale factor
modelled_examples.question: A shape has side 4 cm. The enlargement has side 12 cm. Find the scale factor.
modelled_examples.explanation: Divide the new length by the original length.

modelled_examples.label: Example 2 – using a scale factor
modelled_examples.question: Enlarge a triangle with sides 3, 4, 5 cm by scale factor 2.
modelled_examples.explanation: Every side is multiplied by the same scale factor.

modelled_examples.label: Example 3 – fractional scale factor
modelled_examples.question: Reduce a rectangle 12 cm by 8 cm using SF = &frac{1}{4}.
modelled_examples.explanation: Fractional scale factors make shapes smaller.

modelled_examples.label: Example 4 – map scales
modelled_examples.question: A map scale is 1 : 25 000. Two towns are 6 cm apart on the map. Find the real distance.
modelled_examples.explanation: Map distance × scale = real distance. Then convert units.

practice.heading: Finding scale factors
practice.instruction: Find the scale factor from original to image.

practice.heading: Applying scale factors
practice.instruction: Find the new length after enlargement.

practice.heading: Map scales
practice.instruction: Use the map scale to find real distances.

items.statement: Scale factor = new length ÷ original length
A scale factor of 2 doubles the area
A scale factor between 0 and 1 reduces the shape
1 : 50 000 means 1 cm on map = 50 000 cm in real life
A scale factor less than 1 makes the shape bigger

problems.text: A rectangular garden is 8 m by 12 m. An architect draws it with scale factor &frac{1}{200}. What are the dimensions on the plan in cm? If the garden area in real life is turfed at £5 per m², find the total cost.
Two similar triangles have areas 9 cm² and 81 cm². The smaller triangle has a base of 6 cm. Find the scale factor of enlargement and the base of the larger triangle.
